description: THE CONTROL for the owed-validator family. A PROGRAMMATIC catalog (constructionOverrides.catalogSource 'defined') carrying the three shapes the refusal fixtures degenerate -- a plain node, a language-form placeholder, and a whole-message alternative with a valid expression -- and it CONSTRUCTS. Without it every row in this family says 'something was refused' and none shows that DefaultStrings' constructor accepts a programmatic catalog at all; and because each refusal fixture differs from this one in exactly ONE member, a refusal here can never be the accidental product of a shape the constructor was always going to reject. Its 'files' exist only to satisfy the loader that runs before the override replaces the catalog; nothing reads them.
